# phasetwo_organization (Data Source)

An organization (team) the API client belongs to.

Organizations are not managed by this provider — look one up here and pass its `id` to `phasetwo_cluster`.

Give exactly one of `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Organizations (teams) are referenced, not managed. Create one in the Phase Two console.
data "phasetwo_organization" "team" {
  name = "acme"
}

output "organization_id" {
  value = data.phasetwo_organization.team.id
}

output "my_roles" {
  value = data.phasetwo_organization.team.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the organization. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the organization. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable organization name.
- `roles` (List of String) Roles the API client holds in this organization.
